from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class HousingStartRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single housing start data point extracted from a report."""
    data_month: str | None = Field(description="The month the housing start rate applies to, in YYYY-MM format (e.g., 2022-08)")
    saar_value: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally adjusted annual rate (SAAR) for total US housing starts")
    report_release_date: str | None = Field(description="The release date of the report containing this data point, used to enforce precedence rules")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates data points extracted from a single housing starts document."""
    housing_start_records: list[HousingStartRecord]
